description: Add test coverage for SessionRpcClient and PieceRpcClient in packages/client/src/runtime/

userStories.title: Create RPC test utilities with mock HTTP transport
userStories.description: As a developer, I need test utilities to mock HTTP responses for Effect RPC clients.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/client/src/runtime/__tests__/test-utils.ts
Export makeTestClient helper that creates RPC client with mocked FetchHttpClient
Helper accepts mock response data and returns Effect-compatible test layer
Support both success and error response mocking
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Complete. test-utils.ts exports makeRpcTestLayer and makeMockNetworkErrorLayer helpers with full success/error mocking support.

userStories.title: Test SessionRpcClient methods
userStories.description: As a developer, I need tests verifying SessionRpcClient encodes requests and decodes responses correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/client/src/runtime/__tests__/SessionRpcClient.test.ts
Test startSession encodes payload and decodes SessionStarted response
Test submitNote encodes note data and decodes NoteResult response
Test endSession decodes SessionComplete response
Test startSession handles SessionError from server
Test startSession handles PieceNotFound from server
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Complete. SessionRpcClient.test.ts covers all 3 methods (startSession, submitNote, endSession) with success and error path tests. Also fixed test-utils.ts to use proper ResponseExitEncoded format with Schema.ExitEncoded structure.
